CREATION OF THE NORTH TRANGLE DEWLOPMENT
COMMITTEE. - There is herebf created a North Triangle Development Committee to
study and resolve the problem of security of tenure of the residents in the area:

FUNCTIONS. - The North Triangle Development Committee shall have
the following powers and function_s:

Study and recommend solutions to address the housing and security of
tenure concerns ofthe residents in the area;
Coordinate with other government agencies in order to formulate a
sustainable development program for the area;
Perform such other functions as may be directed by the President.

REPEALING CL/i|ISE, - All executive orders, rules, regulations and
other issuances or parts thereof inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby
repealed or modified accordingly.

EFFECTIWTY.- This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
